claims.claim_text: The indexed George P Condakes is a high-confidence match to George Peter Condakes, an Army veteran whose obituary explicitly describes his OSS service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: He started in the 100th Infantry Division before joining the O.S.S.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact unusual name, 1922 birth year, Massachusetts association, Army service and explicit OSS chronology align across the index, Army row and obituary.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact full name and middle initial are uncommon; the Army row's 1922 birth-year and Massachusetts-residence values align with the obituary's 1922 birth and Boston-area history, and the obituary explicitly supplies the OSS bridge.
claims.temporal_assessment: The obituary places Northeastern attendance before Army draft, the 100th Infantry Division before OSS, and later 82nd Airborne activity during wartime service.
claims.match_notes: No private index identifier selects the Army row, so identity remains high confidence rather than confirmed. The postwar family business is excluded from the pre-OSS model.
